entries.en: to treat (someone) well, to regale with sincerity.
entries.notes: L栏'fratar biens'当为'tratar bien'之讹写，H'奉誠'与M'cong seng'互证'以诚相待'。

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕（仅存汉字'款'，疑作'欵'，或指款项、诚款）
entries.en: 〔Original damaged; gloss uncertain〕—only the character 款 survives.
entries.notes: L/M/R三栏皆空，H栏'款'[疑]，无以为据。

entries.zh: 以好饭食款待；供养、赡养。
entries.en: to regale with good food; to provide for, to support.
to settle a guest at rest; to lodge, to make comfortable.
to entertain a guest; to treat hospitably.
entries.notes: L栏止于'munchas'（下接词残），语意由H'款待'/M'cuan tay'补足。

entries.en: very worldly-wise; well versed in the world's affairs.
entries.notes: L栏与上条重复且与H'極有世事'不相应，疑栏位错行，释义从H/M'guey u sy su'。

entries.zh: 惯纵、溺爱（以零食小惠惯坏小儿）。
entries.en: to pamper, to accustom (a child) with treats.
entries.notes: L栏'regalos, como el niño [残] por cubrir le leche'残缺难解，H'乘慣'/M'seng cuan'指向'惯'义，存疑。

entries.en: to drip; to sprinkle, to water.
entries.notes: H栏字形疑为'滴'，M'te chuy'（滴水）可证，R栏空。

entries.en: to splash, to pour (water).
to sprinkle, to scatter (water).
entries.notes: M'toa'与'洒'常读不合，疑俗读或异文，义从L/H。

entries.en: to spray, to spurt (water).
entries.notes: H栏'燌/濆'两可，据M'pun'与L'regar'取'濆（喷水）'义。

entries.en: to splash water; to throw water.
to haggle, to bargain over a price.
entries.notes: H栏'吥'[疑]与M'chien'难直接对应，义依L'Regatear'。

entries.zh: 沸、煮沸（本条西语栏作'Regatón, vil-（贱价小贩）'，与汉字不合，疑错行）
entries.en: to boil, to bubble up (the Spanish column 'Regatón, vil-' appears misaligned).
entries.notes: H'沸'/M'puig'一致指'煮沸'，与L'Regaton, vil-（贱价小贩）'不合，疑栏位错行。

entries.zh: 小贩（贩卖杂货、零碎物品者）。
entries.en: a petty retailer, huckster (dealer in small wares).
a dealer in fresh fish.

entries.zh: 市政议员、参事（西属马尼拉市政会成员）；字面作'老人、长者'。
entries.en: aldermen, municipal councillors (literally 'elders').
municipal council, municipality; also a regiment.

entries.zh: 关卡、路关（登记往来行旅之处）。
entries.en: a road checkpoint (where travellers are registered); customs pass.
entries.notes: L'Registro de los caminos'与H'關'/M'uan'相合，'registro'于关卡登记义系推断。

entries.en: 〔Original damaged; gloss uncertain〕
entries.notes: H/M/R三栏皆空，L仅残存'Region ... del ayuo'，疑为'región del aire（气之区域）'。
